_note: Semi-manual transcription of CodeRabbit PR reviews (baseline round 2026-09-23). PRs: #1 code-review, #2 supply-chain, #3 deps-js, #4 python SAST, #5 taskflow JS SAST. Locations normalized to canonical cases/ paths + planted lines. detected=true means CodeRabbit flagged the planted issue; summary_matched grades explainability vs expected_summary. 'bonus' notes = case where CodeRabbit is not an expected_tool. Non-planted extra findings (IDOR, DoS, TSV-injection, authz-bypass, sensitive-data-exposure) are logged in notes.md triage, not here, to avoid counting legit-but-unplanted findings as false positives.
